leaf_cluster_summaries.summary: Major cryptocurrencies surge, with Bitcoin nearing $72k and Ethereum reaching $2300.
US Dollar drops below pre-war lows against emerging markets, signaling potential debasement.

MOVE index for interest rate volatility declines toward 70.

US 30-year Treasury yield ranges between 5.16% and 5.33% this month, currently at 5.22%.
Canada CFIB Business Barometer reports conflicting August figures of 57.6 and 57.8.

assignment.selection_rationale: Prioritizing high-impact macro and fundamental data stories over routine market fluctuations. The US Dollar's weakness against emerging markets offers a strong analytical angle on global capital flows. The BofA small business data provides a crucial pulse on the real economy, while the EU gas storage update offers critical energy security context.
